what_to_verify: User can authenticate with real credentials and complete session bootstrap
preconditions: Known-good account; reachable homeserver; iOS and Android devices
steps: Open login screen; enter homeserver/user/pass; submit
expected_result: Login succeeds and app lands in authenticated tabs on both devices

what_to_verify: Behavior is understandable during packet loss/timeout
steps: Attempt login during degraded network; retry after reconnect
expected_result: Clear error appears and retry succeeds without app restart

functional_element: Room list readability at small sizes
what_to_verify: Room rows remain legible and tappable on small screens
steps: Open Messages tab and inspect row density, truncation, tap targets
expected_result: No clipped text; tap targets are usable

what_to_verify: Perceived smoothness under realistic content load
preconditions: Account with many rooms and avatars
expected_result: No severe jank, freezes, or crashes

what_to_verify: Cards are easy to interpret quickly
steps: Review top 20 cards and try primary actions
expected_result: Actions are obvious and card hierarchy is clear
User returns to login and prior session is not silently restored

what_to_verify: Composer is never hidden and feels stable
steps: Focus composer; type multiline text; rotate device
expected_result: Composer remains visible and cursor context preserved

what_to_verify: Long-press opens correct context actions consistently
expected_result: Correct menu opens consistently without accidental trigger

what_to_verify: Users can discover and use overflow/radial actions
steps: Open overflow/radial actions and narrate task completion
expected_result: User can find intended action without confusion

what_to_verify: No overlap/collision at common viewport widths
expected_result: Layout remains readable and controls accessible

what_to_verify: Core workflows can be completed without mouse
steps: Tab/shift-tab through sidebars, header actions, composer, panels
expected_result: Visible focus and logical tab order maintained

what_to_verify: Panel content hierarchy is understandable for first-time user
steps: Open each panel, switch tabs, complete one task
expected_result: User understands purpose and key actions without external guidance

what_to_verify: Session expiration path is clear and non-destructive
expected_result: User is prompted to re-authenticate cleanly and safely

functional_element: Offline behavior for send and navigation
what_to_verify: Errors are actionable and app recovers cleanly
steps: Send message and navigate while offline; restore network
expected_result: Helpful error UI appears and queued/retry behavior is sane
